- ITV: 350000 ≥ 0.80 × 410000 = 328000, giving **5%**.

- Term days = 365. HomeGuard closed 2026-09-11, |0| ≤ 7, so the sale is corroborated. The share is (DAYS(2026-09-11, 2027-04-11) + 1)/365 = (212 + 1)/365.
- Term credit = 1022 × 213/365 = **596.40**.
